newsitem.title: USA: Santa Anita holder supports funding plan.
newsitem.headline: Santa Anita holder supports funding plan.

text.p: A 4.5 percent shareholder in Santa Anita Cos said Tuesday it supports Koll Arcadia Investors LLC and Colony Investments II LLC plans to recapitalize the real estate investment trust.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Franklin Mutual Advisers Inc, a unit of Franklin Resources Inc said also it reached a special agreement to acquire 15 percent interest in businesses to be formed by the duo.

On March 17 Koll and Colony had announced their proposal to recapitalize Santa Anita by providing $116.5 million in equity capital, in return for control of the company. They would also provide $27 per share cash to Santa Anita holders.
Franklin Mutual in its filing said it "supports the significant cash components" of the deal.
However, Franklin said it is concerned about the valuation of the proposals that involve significant non-cash consideration.
The 4.5 percent holder said it presented its views in a April 3 teleconference call with Koll, Colony and Morgan Stanley & Co, the financial adviser to Santa Anita.
At that time, Franklin said it considered the March 17 proposals to "superior to their prior proposals."

A group led by Franklin Resources holds a 4.5 percent stake in Santa Anita, or 515,700 common shares. Its latest transactions include the sale of 600 common shares on February 10 at a price of $29.875 per share, it said in the filing.
Koll Arcadia is an investment partnership composed of principals of the Koll Cos. Colony Investors, which holds about eight percent of the paired stock of Santa Anita, is an equity fund.
